data.message:
Read search-travel legs in Renfe's new time shape

Renfe's search-travel legs now carry departure_station.departure_timestamp
and arrival_station.arrival_timestamp (Madrid local, ±HHMM) instead of
departure_datetime, arrival_datetime and their *_timezone fields. _leg()
read only the old fields, so every search on the new system failed with
api_changed (exit 7). It now reads the old fields when present and the new
ones otherwise. A leg with neither still raises ApiShapeError.

Tests: a new search test feeds the timetable in the new shape and checks the
same trains, times and cheapest fares as the old shape (30, 40, 50, 30 EUR)
and that a leg with no time fields still raises ApiShapeError; a new CLI test
checks the same search exits 0. Both fail on the base source and pass with
the fix. Full offline suite: 695 passed, 15 skipped, 1 failed
(test_legacy.py::test_cli_search_falls_back_with_exit_0), which hard-codes
--date 2026-11-20 and fails on 2026-11-21 because cli.py rejects past dates;
it is unrelated to this change and was not edited.

Not run: `python -m intake.monitoring` (not present in this worktree).

data.message:
Use the saved timetable when its refresh fails

When the saved GTFS timetable is a day old or more and the refresh from
ssl.renfe.com fails, the lookup now parses the saved copy instead of
reporting the timetable as unavailable. Delays, status and watch keep
their ticket-number matches while Renfe's feed is down, because the feed
publishes several weeks ahead. A saved copy that does not parse still
reports the refresh error.

Tests run offline: tests/test_network_delays.py
(test_a_failed_refresh_uses_the_cached_timetable_even_when_it_is_over_a_day_old)
fails on the base source and passes with the change. Full offline suite:
694 passed, 15 skipped, 1 failed. The failure is
tests/test_legacy.py::test_cli_search_falls_back_with_exit_0, which passes
a hardcoded date (2026-11-20) that is now in the past, so the CLI rejects
it with a usage error before any request. It is unrelated to this change
and was not modified.
